title: applied-ml-experiment-scratchpad-2026-03-03
content:
Quick context:
- Trying to get a repeatable eval pipeline for open-model quantized variants (redwood-7b family). Focus: identify quality delta vs perf wins for q4_0 / q4_K / GPTQ-4bit. Also testing prompt sets for instruction-following regressions after quantization.

Today's goals:
- Run batch of evals across three quant configs (fp16, q4_0, gptq-4bit) on 5 prompt suites (instruct, summarization, math, code, dialog).
- Capture latency/throughput from inference runtime (local dev rig + cloud-dedicated endpoint).
- Quick analysis of top 10 failure cases for q4_0.

Experiment notes / commands:
- Local run: python eval/run_eval.py --model redwood-7b --quant q4_0 --dataset eval-suite-v2 --batch-size 4 --max-tokens 512 --out results/q4_0_instruct_2026-03-03.json
- Cloud run: ./scripts/submit_job.sh --endpoint rdw-dedicated-7 --model redwood-7b --quant fp16 --tags "daily-eval"
- Measure latency with /metrics endpoint; record 95p latency and tokens/s.

Quick results (rough):
- fp16 baseline (instruct): avg BLEU/ROUGE/BLEURT baseline. q4_0: BLEURT -1.2 pts avg, ROUGE-L -0.8, hallucination rate +2.5% on summarization suite.
- GPTQ-4bit: closer to fp16 on instruction tasks (BLEURT -0.4) but unstable on long context (>1k tokens) — KV cache mismatch? Need to re-run with full attention config.
- Perf: q4_0 latency down ~12% and tokens/s up ~18% vs fp16 on local A100-ish node with batch=4. Dedicated endpoint shows smaller gains (~6-8%) due to kernel selection differences.

Prompt sets / observations:
- Instruct-v2 prompt tweak: include explicit "format: JSON" for structured outputs — quantized models degrade when output format not strongly specified (more freeform).
- Math prompts: observed more off-by-one in q4_0 when expressions involve nested parentheses. Possibly numeric precision rounding.

Quantization notes / hypotheses:
- q4_0 appears to introduce subtle distribution shifts in activation scaling for certain layers (attention output + MLP). Could try per-channel scale recalibration or GPTQ fine-tune.
- Try GPTQ with 128-samples vs 512-samples to see calibration effect. Lower samples faster but noisier.
- Check KV cache dtype conversions in runtime: are we truncating to float16 somewhere unexpectedly for q4 variants? Issue to triage with infra team.

Top TODOs (short):
- [ ] Re-run GPTQ-4bit with full-context test (>=2048 tokens), capture KV cache traces. (owner: Aditi)
- [ ] Add structured failure capture to eval runner (store prompt + model_output + reference + logits top-k). (owner: Marcus)
- [ ] Create small calibration job: GPTQ 128/256/512 sample sweeps; compare BLEURT + latency. (owner: Zoe)
- [ ] Open infra ticket: confirm runtime kernel for q4_0 on dedicated cluster (tag: serving-runtime). (owner: Aditi)
- [ ] Write up a short confluence note with top 10 q4_0 failure cases and example inputs. (owner: Aditi, due EOW)

Open questions / things to check:
- Is there a bias shift in generation (more conservative / shorter outputs) after q4 quantization? Need length-normalized metrics.
- Can we reproduce the hallucination spike on summarization with a minimal prompt? If yes, test whether adding explicit "Do not invent facts" reduces delta.
- Are kernels on dedicated endpoints using the same optimized attention impl as local dev? If not, request parity or note in benchmarking.

Notes to self (playbook):
- Keep experiment names explicit: <model>-<quant>-<suite>-<date> so we can grep quickly.
- Save raw logits occasionally (sample ONCE per run) to debug token-collapse cases.
- When filing confluence, include small reproducer and 3 example prompts (good, bad, ambiguous).

Random TODO reminders:
- ping infra about GPU memory leak observed in long-running eval (noticed 2026-02-28).
- sync with Zoe re: code eval harness (she added new metric hooks).

Scratchy notes / shorthand:
- perf delta smaller on dedicated => kernel mismatch or input distribution diff (batching behavior?).
- consider adding small LM-ft on quantized weights (distillation) to recover BLEURT loss if promising.

End of day quick summary:
- q4_0 shows meaningful perf wins but measurable quality regressions on some tasks. GPTQ-4bit promising but needs full-context runs. Next steps: calibration sweep + failure-case doc.

Links referenced: PR 842 (runtime changes), JIRA ML-567 (quant job tracking), Confluence redwood-1234 (initial eval spec).
